random.description: This is a clinical photograph of a human hand resting on blue fabric. The index finger displays petechial hemorrhages and other small dark spots near the fingertip, while a small black rectangle has been placed as a marker on the middle phalanx. The visual findings and finger lesions are characteristic of acute infective endocarditis presenting with splinter hemorrhages. These peripheral manifestations help clinicians identify systemic embolic or immune-mediated vascular events.
